scope: train partition only; no 2018/2019 prediction or tuning
zero_positive_policy: keep fold; AP/ROC-AUC/recall null; report review burden, do not average undefined AP as zero
selection_policy: diagnostic comparisons only; one seed, one configuration each; no automatic winner or tuning after results
limitations: Eligibility inspection found zero positives in 2017-H1 and 63 in H2 before freezing this protocol.
Stronger regularization is a bundle, not three isolated parameter effects.
Daily top-K forces a full review queue even when every transaction is normal.
